listing.name: Pangya: Fantasy Golf — pangya-recomp (kromossomom-debug)
listing.summary: Experimental project. Static native title code with HLE/fallback; no broad gameplay or full completion established. These are the project’s reports; See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA ULUS10438 Pangya: Fantasy Golf UMD ISO. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Run build.sh with your own ISO to patch the PPSSPP HLE runtime and generate the game’s C++ code. The resulting dist/pangya player still uses the original ISO. Portcove does not manage this download and has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

warnings: This uses statically translated native game code with HLE and fallback. Broad gameplay and full completion have not been established. These are the project’s reports; Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
